description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing shipping extensions in the Opencart admin panel. It includes methods for listing available shipping extensions, installing, and uninstalling them, and handles permissions, loading related models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping extensions in the admin backend, providing functionalities for listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point that outputs the list of shipping extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed shipping extensions, including permissions, language loading, and view rendering.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a shipping extension, including permission checks, file existence, model updates, permission assignment, and autoload registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a shipping extension, including permission checks, model updates, and calling uninstall methods.
